# inter-rater reliability 
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)


coded_dir <- "/Users/ninacurko/Downloads/coded"   
all_files <- list.files(coded_dir, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
```


```{r}
file_info <- tibble(path = all_files) %>%
  mutate(
    fname  = basename(path),
    subID  = str_extract(fname, "s[0-9]+"),          # e.g. "s009"
    rater  = str_extract(fname, "(CF|ZT)(?=\\.xlsx$)") # last CF/ZT before .xlsx
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subID), !is.na(rater))


subs_both <- file_info %>%
  count(subID, rater) %>%
  count(subID) %>%
  filter(n == 2) %>%
  pull(subID)

cat("Subjects scored by both raters:", paste(subs_both, collapse = ", "), "\n")


subs_to_use <- intersect(subs_both, c("s007", "s012"))
cat("Using subjects:", paste(subs_to_use, collapse = ", "), "\n")

file_info_both <- file_info %>% filter(subID %in% subs_to_use)
```


```{r}
recall.data <- data.frame()
for (cur.file in file_info_both$path) {
  cur.data <- read_xlsx(cur.file, n_max = 48)
  cur.data %>%
    mutate(coder = ifelse(grepl(pattern = "ZT", x = cur.file), "ZT",
                          ifelse(grepl(pattern = "CF", x = cur.file), "CF", NA))) -> cur.data
  recall.data <- bind_rows(recall.data, cur.data)
}
 
filter(recall.data, coder == "ZT") -> ztcoder_sorted
filter(recall.data, coder == "CF") -> cfcoder_sorted
 
ztcoder_sorted <- ztcoder_sorted[order(ztcoder_sorted$videoName), ]
ztcoder_sorted <- ztcoder_sorted[order(ztcoder_sorted$subID), ]
cfcoder_sorted <- cfcoder_sorted[order(cfcoder_sorted$videoName), ]
cfcoder_sorted <- cfcoder_sorted[order(cfcoder_sorted$subID), ]
 

stopifnot(nrow(ztcoder_sorted) == nrow(cfcoder_sorted))
 
event_sorted   <- cor(cfcoder_sorted$eventDetails,   ztcoder_sorted$eventDetails)
visual_sorted  <- cor(cfcoder_sorted$visualDetails,  ztcoder_sorted$visualDetails)
correct_sorted <- cor(cfcoder_sorted$correctDetails, ztcoder_sorted$correctDetails)
total_sorted   <- cor(cfcoder_sorted$totalDetails,   ztcoder_sorted$totalDetails)
 

cat("Event:  ", round(event_sorted, 3),  "\n")
cat("Visual: ", round(visual_sorted, 3), "\n")
cat("Correct:", round(correct_sorted, 3), "\n")
cat("Total:  ", round(total_sorted, 3), "\n")
 

```



## average number of valence related trials after motion exclusions 


use any network.data type dataframe from other scripts
```{r}
trials_retained <- network.data.reviewer %>%
  filter(conditionName == "remember") %>%          
  distinct(subID, trial, valenceCategory) %>%      # one row per trial per subject
  group_by(subID, valenceCategory) %>%
  summarise(n_trials = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(valenceCategory) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_trials = mean(n_trials),
    sd_trials   = sd(n_trials),
    min_trials  = min(n_trials),
    max_trials  = max(n_trials),
    n_subjects  = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
 
print(trials_retained)
 
```



# emotional valence categories and continuous valence ratings 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

#using mem.data from main univariate script - you may have to specify a path for this to work. 
mem.data = readRDS("mem.data_reframe-detail.rds")


valence_df <- mem.data %>%
  filter(conditionName == "remember") %>%
  group_by(subID, cueWord, valenceCategory) %>%
  summarise(
    encValence = first(na.omit(encValence)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Total rows:", nrow(valence_df), "\n")
cat("Rows with a usable rating:", sum(!is.na(valence_df$encValence)), "\n\n") # some ratings weren't completed 

# Set factor order
valence_df$valenceCategory <- factor(
  valence_df$valenceCategory,
  levels = c("neg", "neu", "pos"))
```

```{r}
descriptives <- valence_df %>%
  group_by(valenceCategory) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rating = round(mean(encValence, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_rating   = round(sd(encValence, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    n           = sum(!is.na(encValence)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(descriptives)
```

```{r}
anova_model <- aov(
  encValence ~ valenceCategory,
  data = valence_df
)

print(summary(anova_model))

ss <- summary(anova_model)[[1]][["Sum Sq"]]
eta_sq <- ss[1] / sum(ss)

cat("Eta-squared:", round(eta_sq, 3), "\n\n")

print(TukeyHSD(anova_model))
```

## Figure 1c


calc subject means for plotting 
```{r}
subject_means <- valence_df %>%
  group_by(subID, valenceCategory) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_enc = mean(encValence, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}

p_box <- ggplot(
  subject_means,
  aes(x = valenceCategory, y = mean_enc)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = valenceCategory),
    width = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = valenceCategory),
    width = 0.08,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "neg" = "negative",
      "neu" = "neutral",
      "pos" = "positive"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "neg" = "#e3401a",
      "neu" = "#1f78b4",
      "pos" = "#33a02c"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "neg" = "#e3401a",
      "neu" = "#1f78b4",
      "pos" = "#33a02c"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Valence category",
    y = "Mean valence rating at encoding"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")
  )

print(p_box)
```
